tagline: Clean, pesticide-free hydroponic tomatoes from a second-generation grower.
about: Poole Mill Produce is a second-generation hydroponic farm. Growing up, the owner helped her dad grow hydroponic tomatoes and cucumbers; in 2012 she and her husband Emanuel bought their own hydroponic operation. Everything is grown free of pesticides and herbicides and sold locally.
highlights: Uses about 1/20 of the water of soil growing
Accepts Farmers' Market gift certificates and Market Bucks

services.name: Hydroponic tomatoes
services.description: Grown in a controlled environment with nutrients fed straight to the roots.

services.name: Restaurants & grocery stores
services.description: Already sold to local restaurants and grocery stores.
